meta.title: Chimney Service Prices In Toronto | Northmark Chimney
meta.description: How chimney work is priced in Toronto & the GTA: a {{site.offer_price}} standard sweep this winter with a free inspection; repairs priced at your home before any work.

hero.h1: What Chimney Work Costs In Toronto
hero.p: Straight answer: for anything beyond a standard sweep, nobody can price a chimney honestly without seeing it. So we come and look for free, and you get the exact number at your home — before any work starts.
hero.t-2: Free inspection at your home — a real look, then a price on the spot

img.alt: Repaired brick chimney photographed by Northmark after the job

p1.h2: The One Price We Can Publish
p1.p: A standard chimney sweep, this winter.
p1.p-4: A full chimney sweep with the free inspection included — we look inside the flue, show you the photos, and tell you if anything else needs doing. Nothing else starts without your OK.
p1.p-5: Winter pricing for a standard chimney sweep, inspection included. Call and we will confirm it for your chimney before booking.

p2.p: Five things decide what a chimney job costs. This is what we are looking at during the free inspection.
p2.p-2: A single open fireplace is a different job from a chimney serving a fireplace and a furnace.
p2.p-3: A walkable roof, a steep roof or a third storey all change how long the work takes and what equipment comes along.
p2.p-4: A light seasonal layer sweeps out quickly. Years of hardened creosote does not.
p2.p-5: A cracked crown, a missing cap or open mortar joints are repairs, priced separately from a sweep.
p2.p-6: Wood, gas and oil leave different deposits behind and are inspected differently.

p3.h2: Why You Will Not Find A Price List Here
p3.p: Plenty of sites publish a range so wide it tells you nothing, then quote something different once they are at your door. We would rather not start that way.
p3.p-2: Two chimneys on the same street can need completely different work. One needs an hour with a brush. The other has a cracked crown letting water into the brickwork, and sweeping it would be the least useful thing we could do that day.
p3.p-3: So the order is: free inspection, photographs of what we found, then a price you can say no to. If you do say no, you have lost nothing and you know what your chimney needs.
p3.p-4: Whatever the price turns out to be, it covers work we stand behind: both the materials we fit and the labour carry a warranty. If something we installed fails, we come back and put it right.

faq.q: How much does a chimney sweep cost in Toronto?
faq.p: Our winter price is {{site.offer_price}} for a standard chimney sweep, with the inspection included. Chimneys differ, so call {{site.phone}} and we will confirm it for yours before booking.
faq.q-2: Why do you not publish a price for repairs?
faq.p-2: Because a repair price that is not based on seeing the chimney is a guess, and a guess either wastes your time or turns into a bill you did not agree to. We look first, then give you the number.
faq.p-3: Yes. A technician comes to your home, inspects the chimney, and gives you a price on the spot. No obligation, and nothing starts without your OK.
faq.q-4: Do you charge extra for evenings or weekends?
faq.p-4: We work every day, {{site.hours}}, at the same price. Call {{site.phone}} for the earliest slot in your area.
faq.q-5: Is the work covered by a warranty?
faq.p-5: Yes. Every job carries a warranty that covers both the materials we fit and the labour. If something we installed fails, we come back and put it right.
faq.q-6: How do I get an exact price?
faq.p-6: Call {{site.phone}} or leave your details below. We book a free inspection, and you get the exact price at your home before any work begins.
